name: jasonzhu-ai
title: JasonZhu.AI
description: jasonzhu.ai does not run a remote MCP server. There is no MCP endpoint to connect to, so this card lists no transport. What the site offers agents: read-only WebMCP tools that its pages register in the browser (listed under tools), and plain HTTPS files that need no MCP (listed in instructions).
instructions: Without a browser, read these over plain HTTPS: https://jasonzhu.ai/llms.txt (site guide and citation rules), https://jasonzhu.ai/agents.md (what an agent may and may not do on this site), https://jasonzhu.ai/data/payment-guard.json (payment-platform data with check dates), https://jasonzhu.ai/feed/blog.xml and https://jasonzhu.ai/feed/news.xml (RSS). The tools below exist only inside a jasonzhu.ai page loaded in a browser that supports WebMCP (navigator.modelContext). An MCP client cannot call them through this card.

tools.name: search_jasonzhu_articles
tools.title: Search the link list in llms.txt
tools.description: WebMCP, registered by a page script. Fetches /llms.txt and returns up to 20 of its link lines that contain the keyword, plus the blog URL. It does not search article text.

query.description: Keyword to look for in the link lines of /llms.txt.

lang.description: Language of the returned blog URL.

tools.name: search_jasonzhu_blog
tools.title: Filter the blog list
tools.description: WebMCP, declared by the search form in the page footer. Opens /{lang}/blog?q={keyword}; the page filters its article list in the browser.

q.description: Keyword to filter the blog list by.

tools.name: get_going_global_guides
tools.title: Links to the going-global guides
tools.description: WebMCP, registered by a page script. Returns five fixed links: the going-global hub, the payment selector, the account-opening guide, GoSail Club and services. It does no lookup.
